svg.title: How the working method changed
svg.desc: A sequence of working habits from tools to coordinated factory operation, not an invented dated roadmap. System model: How the working method changed. Compose tools Plugins · APIs Services. Work in a pair One human One agent. Delegate work A bounded task A clear owner. Work in parallel Competing changes Independent review. Qualify the result Exact revision Named release gates. Operate a factory Intent → work → evidence. A sequence of working habits, not an invented dated roadmap. Founding public account: 28 September 2026.
